case_number: 2025 INSC 11; Criminal Appeal No. of 2024 (@ SLP (Crl.) No. 10737 of 2023)

parties.petitioner: The State, Central Bureau of Investigation

summary: Jurisdictional challenge to CBI investigation and prosecution under DSPE Act, 1946 s.6 and Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988; lack of state consent and absence of special court notification held to vitiate proceedings; High Court's quashing of chargesheets upheld; transfer of cases not challenged; inherent lack of jurisdiction due to no consent from Andhra Pradesh government and unnotified Special Court under PC Act.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946 s.6
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment allowing writ petitions upheld; proceedings quashed due to lack of jurisdiction.
